Hymn.title: Hymn
Hymn.description: Represents a single hymn in the Himnario EECH Móvil application, including its unique number, title, and complete lyrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hymn entity.

number.description: The unique numerical identifier of the hymn within the hymnal.

title.description: The official title of the hymn.

lyrics.description: The complete text of the hymn's lyrics.

keywords.description: Additional keywords or phrases related to the hymn's content, aiding in search functionality.

Praise.title: Praise
Praise.description: Represents a single praise song, including its title, lyrics and tone.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Praise entity (slug of the title).

title.description: The official title of the praise song.

lyrics.description: The complete text of the praise song's lyrics.

tone.description: The musical key of the praise song.

speed.description: The speed or rhythm of the song, for classification.

Choir.title: Choir
Choir.description: Represents a single choir song, including its title, lyrics and tone.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Choir entity (slug of the title).

title.description: The official title of the choir song.

lyrics.description: The complete text of the choir song's lyrics.

tone.description: The musical key of the choir song.

speed.description: The speed or rhythm of the song, for classification.

YouthChoir.title: YouthChoir
YouthChoir.description: Represents a single song from church groups (Alabanzas de Agrupaciones).

id.description: Unique identifier for the song entity (slug of the title).

title.description: The official title of the song.

lyrics.description: The complete text of the song's lyrics.

tone.description: The musical key of the song.

group.description: The specific church group this song belongs to.

Repertoire.title: Repertoire
Repertoire.description: Represents a user-created repertoire or song list for a service.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and preferences within the application, such as their preferred font size and favorite hymns. This entity represents the app user, assuming an external authentication system handles login details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This ID typically originates from an external authentication system or is a unique device ID.

preferredFontSize.description: The user's preferred font size for displaying hymn lyrics. This is a UI preference.

FavoriteHymn.title: FavoriteHymn
FavoriteHymn.description: Links a specific hymn to a user's profile, indicating it has been marked as a favorite for quick access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FavoriteHymn relationship entity.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who marked this hymn as a favorite. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FavoriteHymn)

hymnId.description: Reference to the Hymn that has been marked as a favorite. (Relationship: Hymn 1:N FavoriteHymn)

addedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the hymn was added to the favorites list.

definition.description: Stores all public hymn data, including number, title, and lyrics. This collection is publicly readable by all users. No authorization-specific fields are required as data is public.

params.name: hymnId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific hymn.

definition.description: Stores all public praise song data.

params.name: praiseId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific praise.

definition.description: Stores all public choir song data.

params.name: choirId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific choir song.

params.name: youthChoirId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific group song.

params.name: repertoireId
params.description: The unique identifier for the repertoire.

definition.description: Stores individual user preferences and settings, such as preferred font size. Each document represents a single user's profile and is only readable/writable by the owning user. The 'id' field in the document MUST match the 'userId' from the path and 'request.auth.uid' for explicit ownership and authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, corresponding to Firebase Authentication's UID.

definition.description: Represents a hymn that a specific user has marked as a favorite. Documents in this subcollection are only readable/writable by the owning user. Includes denormalized 'userProfileId' (matching 'userId' from the path and 'request.auth.uid') for authorization independence, and 'hymnId' to link to the public hymn data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user who owns this favorite hymn entry.

params.name: favoriteHymnId
params.description: The unique identifier for this specific favorite hymn entry within the user's list.
